how_its_made:
Deps:

Rings P2P (WebRTC, WASM, DHT, Rust)    (My pervious work)
Nova (Folding Scheme, IVC, Bellman(bellpepper)
Rings SNARK – load r1cs and wasm to WASM   (My pervious work)
Web3JS (for generate random Ethereum account in browser)

The demo details:

1. Establish connection between browsers (with NO server)
2. Load WASM and R1CS which precompiled via circom
3. Gen Nova’s RelexR1CS, and do SNARK setup
4. distribute tasks to nodes.
5. fold, proof and verify
